name: Mahanadi Coalfields
summary: Mahanadi Coalfields, a Coal India subsidiary incorporated in 1992, mines non-coking coal from 17 mines in Odisha's Talcher and Ib Valley coalfields and produced 218.31 million tonnes in FY26, about 21% of India's output. Revenue from operations slipped from ₹31,634 cr in FY24 to ₹30,550 cr in FY26 and profit after tax fell 1.2% in FY26 to ₹10,698 cr, though return on net worth was about 54% and the company is almost debt-free. At the upper band of ₹136 the company is valued at about ₹90,010 cr, or about 8.4x FY26 earnings, in line with the cheapest of its RHP peers, and the ₹8,981 cr issue is entirely an offer for sale by Coal India, so the company receives no money. Contingent liabilities were about 56% of net worth at September 2026, and top 10 customers, mainly thermal power utilities, give 55.9% of revenue.

checks.name: Revenue growth
checks.finding: Revenue from operations fell from ₹31,634 cr (FY24) to ₹30,550 cr (FY26), a CAGR of about -1.7%.

checks.name: Revenue rose every year
checks.finding: Revenue from operations fell in both years: ₹31,634 cr, ₹31,353 cr, ₹30,550 cr (FY24–FY26).

checks.name: Debt to equity
checks.finding: Borrowings were about ₹3 cr at March 2026 against net worth of ₹21,371 cr, so debt to equity is close to zero.

checks.name: Debt growing slower than revenue
checks.finding: Total borrowings fell from ₹3.95 cr (FY24) to ₹3.16 cr (FY26).

checks.name: Net worth rising
checks.finding: Net worth rose every year: ₹16,120 cr, ₹18,343 cr, ₹21,371 cr (FY24–FY26).

checks.name: Positive operating cash flow
checks.finding: Operating cash flow was ₹12,478 cr in FY26, above the ₹10,698 cr profit.

checks.name: Profit growth
checks.finding: Profit after tax fell 1.2% in FY26, to ₹10,698 cr from ₹10,825 cr, after falling from ₹11,842 cr in FY24.

checks.name: Profit margin trend
checks.finding: PAT as a share of total income fell from about 35.3% (FY24) to 31.6% (FY26).

checks.name: Return on equity
checks.finding: Return on net worth was 53.87% in FY26, down from 62.82% in FY25 and 80.56% in FY24.

checks.name: Return on capital employed
checks.finding: ROCE was 73.26% in FY26.

checks.name: Margin vs listed peers
checks.finding: Peer margins were not found in public sources.

checks.name: P/E vs listed peers
checks.finding: At ₹136 the P/E is about 8.4x FY26 EPS of ₹16.13, at or below the RHP peer median of about 8.5x (Coal India 8.05x, NMDC 8.47x, PT Bukit Asam 11.40x).

checks.name: Price to book vs listed peers
checks.finding: Price to book is about 4.2x (₹136 vs FY26 NAV of ₹32.29), but peer price-to-book figures were not found.

checks.name: Market cap to sales vs listed peers
checks.finding: Market cap to sales is about 2.9x (₹90,010 cr vs ₹30,550 cr revenue), but peer market-cap-to-sales figures were not found.

checks.name: Recent pre-IPO share price
checks.finding: The RHP reports no pre-IPO placement and no share acquisitions by Coal India in the preceding year.

checks.name: Promoter holding after the issue
checks.finding: Promoters (Coal India and the President of India) hold 100% before and 90% after the issue.

checks.name: No pledged promoter shares
checks.finding: No information on pledged promoter shares was found.

checks.name: Related-party transactions
checks.finding: FY26 related-party transactions were ₹8,386 cr, 27.45% of revenue, mostly the ₹7,650 cr dividend paid to Coal India.

checks.name: No regulatory action against promoters
checks.finding: No information on regulatory action against promoters was found.

checks.name: Offer for sale share of the issue
checks.finding: The whole issue is an offer for sale of 66.18 crore shares by Coal India; there is no fresh issue.

checks.name: Free float after listing
checks.finding: The offer is about 10% of the company; promoter holding falls from 100% to 90%.

checks.name: Selling shareholders' cost
checks.finding: Coal India's weighted average acquisition cost is ₹0.26 per share, so ₹136 is over 500 times its cost.

checks.name: Money for growth
checks.finding: The company receives none of the proceeds, so nothing funds capex or expansion.

checks.name: Debt repayment share
checks.finding: No proceeds go to repaying debt; all go to the selling shareholder.

checks.name: General corporate purposes
checks.finding: No proceeds go to general corporate purposes; all go to the selling shareholder.

checks.name: No repayment to promoter entities
checks.finding: No proceeds reach the company, so none repay loans from promoters or group companies.

checks.name: Litigation against the company
checks.finding: The RHP lists 42 direct-tax cases worth ₹8,082 cr and a ₹2,566 cr village compensation claim against the company, together about half of net worth.

checks.name: Criminal or regulatory cases
checks.finding: The DRHP lists 47 criminal and 52 regulatory proceedings; public sources don't say how material they are.

checks.name: Contingent liabilities
checks.finding: Contingent liabilities were ₹12,513 cr, 55.86% of net worth, at September 30, 2026.

checks.name: Customer concentration
checks.finding: Top 10 customers gave 55.94% of FY26 revenue from operations; thermal power was 68.62% of sales.

checks.name: Supplier dependence
checks.finding: Top 10 contractors took 60.02% of contract expenses, but no single-supplier share was found.

checks.name: Operating history
checks.finding: Incorporated on April 3, 1992, giving over 34 years of operating history.

checks.name: Auditor remarks
checks.finding: Auditor remarks were not found in public sources.
